title.rendered: Arqaam Capital and Alētheia Capital have joined forces to connect global investors with deeper MENA market insights

content.rendered:
This partnership combines Arqaam’s decade-long track record and largest MENA research footprint—26 analysts, 230+ companies—with Alētheia’s worldwide distribution network and global macro expertise.

“Partnering with Alētheia represents a strategic step forward in broadening the global reach of our Institutional Equities platform… this collaboration positions us to play a central role in shaping investor access and engagement across the region.” – Jaap Meijer & Hani Shalabi, Arqaam Capital

Together, we are strengthening the bridge between MENA markets and the global investment community.

View More
